audience.title.en: Who to make the first titles for
audience.title.zh: 首批剧集面向哪些观众

audience.intro.en: Published audience research and story-selection evidence. Independent of demo campaigns and the listing filters above.
audience.intro.zh: 参考公开受众研究和选题依据。独立于演示广告数据，不随上方剧库筛选变化。

audience.reviewed.en: Sources checked {date} · Historical findings, not a live audience feed
audience.reviewed.zh: 来源核验于 {date} · 历史研究，非实时受众数据

audience.reelshort.en: ReelShort: {share}% of its US users were female

audience.reelshort.scope.en: Sensor Tower's 2024 report, page 13. App-level estimate; the gender chart does not specify its measurement window or sample size. It does not identify paying users or the audience of an individual genre.
audience.reelshort.scope.zh: 来自 Sensor Tower 2024 年报告第 13 页。属于应用层面的估算；性别图未注明统计期间或样本量，不能代表付费用户或某一题材的观众。

audience.genre.title.zh: 有研究依据的爱情题材方向

audience.genre.finding.en: Sensor Tower associates werewolf, billionaire/wealthy-family and vampire stories with Western female audiences. This is the report's qualitative interpretation, not a demographic-by-genre measurement.
audience.genre.finding.zh: Sensor Tower 将狼人、霸总、豪门和吸血鬼题材与欧美女性观众的偏好联系起来。这是报告的定性解读，并非按题材统计的受众画像。

audience.selection.en: Selection hypothesis: request female-led romance candidates in these directions, including Alpha/supernatural and billionaire/status-conflict stories. Age targeting stays open until stronger evidence is available.
audience.selection.zh: 选片假设：优先征集这些方向的女性主线爱情剧，包括 Alpha / 超自然爱情、霸总及身份阶层冲突。年龄暂不设硬性限制，等待更充分的证据。

audience.demand.title.zh: 美国剧集需求参考 · YouGov，2025 年

audience.demand.scope.en: YouGov lists these five titles as leading US vertical shorts by online demand in its September 2025 publication. Search/social demand is not verified viewing, revenue, or a demographic breakdown; the public summary does not specify the exact measurement window or sample size.
audience.demand.scope.zh: YouGov 在 2025 年 9 月发布的研究中，将以下五部列为美国网络需求领先的竖屏短剧。搜索与社媒需求不等于实际观看、收入或受众画像；公开摘要未注明精确统计期间和样本量。

audience.channels.title.en: Where US age groups and women use social media
audience.channels.title.zh: 美国各年龄段及女性使用哪些社媒

audience.channels.scope.en: Pew Research Center, Feb 5–Jun 18, 2025; survey of 5,022 US adults. General platform use, not short-drama customers. Age and gender are separate breakdowns.
audience.channels.scope.zh: Pew Research Center 于 2025 年 2 月 5 日至 6 月 18 日调查了 5,022 名美国成年人。反映一般平台使用情况，不代表短剧用户；年龄与性别为分别统计。

audience.channels.caption.en: Share of each US demographic group who say they ever use the platform
audience.channels.caption.zh: 各美国人口群体中表示使用过该平台的比例

audience.channels.example.en: For example, 78% of US women use Facebook; this does not mean 78% of Facebook users are women. These figures say nothing about what any group prefers to watch.
audience.channels.example.zh: 例如，78% 的美国女性使用 Facebook，并不意味着 Facebook 用户中女性占 78%。这些数据不能说明任何群体的题材偏好。

audience.gaps.detail.en: No verified US age × gender × genre dataset has been retrieved, and DramaBox's US demographic split is unverified. Public popularity and company target-audience settings cannot fill these gaps.
audience.gaps.detail.zh: 尚未获取经核实的美国年龄 × 性别 × 题材数据，DramaBox 美国用户的年龄与性别分布也未核实。公开热度和公司目标受众设置无法补足这些数据。

audience.access.en: YouTube audience demographics require access to the channel's analytics. TikTok documents pre-campaign audience estimates, but no genre-specific results have been retrieved. Facebook interest-audience availability still needs account-level verification. None of these is connected here.
audience.access.zh: YouTube 受众画像需要频道分析权限。TikTok 文档提供投放前受众估算功能，但尚未获取具体题材的结果。Facebook 兴趣受众数据是否可用仍需在账号中核实；此处均未接入。

audience.sources.note.en: Manually reviewed publications. Original periods and denominators are preserved; these are not live feeds or campaign results.
audience.sources.note.zh: 经人工核验的公开研究，保留原始统计期间与分母，不是实时数据或广告结果。

audience.sources.refresh.en: Re-read by hand when a newer publication appears; never a live feed.
audience.sources.refresh.zh: 出现更新版本时人工重新核验，不是实时数据。
